title: The Base Change Of Fundamental Group Schemes
summary: Let $k$ be a field, $K/k$ a field extension, $X$ a connected scheme proper over $k$, $x_K\in X_K(K)$ lying over $x\in X(k)$, $\mathcal{C}_X$ and $\mathcal{C}_{X_K}$ the Tannakian categories whose objects consist of vector bundles on $X$ and $X_K$ respectively, $π(\mathcal{C}_X,x)$ and $π(\mathcal{C}_{X_K},x_K)$ the corresponding Tannaka group schemes respectively. We establish a unified criterion determining when the base change homomorphism $π(\mathcal{C}_{X_K},x_K)\rightarrow π(\mathcal{C}_X,x)_K$ is faithfully flat or an isomorphism.
